what: IFEval accepts a title via re.findall(r'<<[^\n]+>>', value); that marker is also ordinary left-shift/right-shift operator and shell heredoc/redirect syntax, so a single line containing 'a << b >> c' is credited with a title that was never written (false pass).

method.corpus: 5 hand-traced cases; verdict = checker vs intended semantic.
method.exposure: count of prompts requiring a title; checker verdicts on their GPT-4 responses; marker occurrences across all responses with examples for manual inspection (no auto-labelling of real data).
